question: Should OpenClaw expose outbound delivery failures to agents as a shared system event, a structured message-tool/agent delivery status, or both?
rationale: The choice affects model-visible context, channel/plugin SDK contracts, and recovery semantics, so source inspection cannot safely choose the permanent contract without maintainer intent.

options.title: Shared Typed Delivery Contract
options.body: Define a single delivery-failure/status contract over existing durable outbound outcomes and decide exactly where agents may observe it.

options.title: Tool/Status Only
options.body: Limit the change to structured agent and message-tool result status without injecting new system events into session context.

options.title: Keep Narrow Paths
options.body: Treat current CLI, Gateway, cron, restart-recovery, and channel-specific handling as sufficient and close the request as not planned.

recommendation.title: Shared Typed Delivery Contract
recommendation.body: Define a single delivery-failure/status contract over existing durable outbound outcomes and decide exactly where agents may observe it.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision spans the shared outbound lifecycle, agent delivery, and plugin/channel contract history where this person has the strongest provenance signal.
